title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental: Free Move-In Truck Limited to One per Storage Unit
content:
**Offer terms — the free move-in truck of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental.**

**Clause 1.** The free move-in truck is a benefit of a storage unit rental, not of the customer. Each storage unit rental agreement supports **1** free move-in truck rental, and a customer moving into two units may claim it once for each unit.

**Clause 2.** A cancelled or no-show reservation does not use the benefit.

**Clause 3.** Use of the benefit is counted per storage unit rental agreement over all time: the truck rentals that carry that agreement as their linked storage unit and carry a free move-in waiver credit, leaving out cancelled and no-show rentals.

**Clause 4.** Before a free move-in credit is given, the company's records of truck rentals linked to the same storage unit agreement are checked: another truck rental linked to that agreement and standing in reserved, picked-up, returned or closed status is a separate record holding that unit's free move-in truck rental; a cancelled or no-show rental is not.

**Clause 5 (retired).** The free move-in truck is never combined with another discount on the same contract. — This clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis of the free move-in rental waiver.

## Points of judgement

| Situation (hypothetical) | Outcome under clauses 1 to 4 |
|---|---|
| A customer moves into one storage unit | One free move-in truck rental for that unit |
| A customer moves into two storage units | One free move-in truck rental for each unit, two in all |
| The only earlier truck rental linked to the unit was cancelled | The unit's benefit is unused |
| The only earlier truck rental linked to the unit became a no-show | The unit's benefit is unused |
| Another truck rental linked to the same unit stands in reserved, picked-up, returned or closed status | That rental is a separate record holding the unit's free move-in truck rental |

superseded_clauses: The free move-in truck is never combined with another discount on the same contract.
